summary: Anthropic announces Claude 3.7 Sonnet, the first hybrid reasoning model, and Claude Code, a command-line tool for agentic coding. The model is available on all Claude plans and major cloud platforms, with extended thinking mode and API control over thinking budget. Claude Code is in limited research preview, and the GitHub integration is now available on all plans.

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet is the first hybrid reasoning model on the market.
claims.evidence_quote: the first hybrid reasoning model on the market

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet is available on all Claude plans, including Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise, as well as the Claude Developer Platform, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud's Vertex AI.
claims.evidence_quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet is now available on all Claude plans—including Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise—as well as the Claude Developer Platform, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud’s Vertex AI.

claims.text: Extended thinking mode is not available on the free Claude tier.
claims.evidence_quote: Extended thinking mode is available on all surfaces except the free Claude tier.

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, including thinking tokens.
claims.evidence_quote: $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens—which includes thinking tokens.

claims.text: API users can control the thinking budget up to 128K tokens.
claims.evidence_quote: you can tell Claude to think for no more than N tokens, for any value of N up to its output limit of 128K tokens.

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-bench Verified.
claims.evidence_quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-bench Verified

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves state-of-the-art performance on TAU-bench.
claims.evidence_quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves state-of-the-art performance on TAU-bench

claims.text: Claude Code is Anthropic's first agentic coding tool, available in limited research preview.
claims.evidence_quote: introducing Claude Code—our first agentic coding tool—in a limited research preview.

claims.text: Claude Code can search and read code, edit files, write and run tests, commit and push code to GitHub, and use command line tools.
claims.evidence_quote: Claude Code is an active collaborator that can search and read code, edit files, write and run tests, commit and push code to GitHub, and use command line tools

claims.text: In early testing, Claude Code completed tasks in a single pass that would normally take 45+ minutes of manual work.
claims.evidence_quote: Claude Code completed tasks in a single pass that would normally take 45+ minutes of manual work

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet reduces unnecessary refusals by 45% compared to its predecessor.
The GitHub integration is now available on all Claude plans.
claims.evidence_quote: Our GitHub integration is now available on all Claude plans

claims.text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet is optimized for real-world tasks rather than math and computer science competition problems.
claims.evidence_quote: we’ve optimized somewhat less for math and computer science competition problems, and instead shifted focus towards real-world tasks
